Field.Label: Two clicks and about two minutes. Indigo has to let go of the stick while it is read.
1. Choose Interfaces, Z-Wave, Disable in the Indigo client (before or after pressing Start, either order works).

2. Press Start. The plugin waits for Z-Wave to go off, reads the controller twice, checks the copies match, and writes the image. Watch the Event Log: it tells you when to choose Interfaces, Z-Wave, Enable again.

This writes an image back into the controller's memory. It only goes onto the same model running the same software version as the stick the image came from; the plugin refuses anything else. Afterwards the plugin resets the stick (a 500-series stick also needs an unplug and replug, which the Event Log asks for), reads it back to check the image took, and tells you to switch Z-Wave back on.
Replacement stick
Field.Description: Tick if this image goes onto a different stick of the same model (its Home ID will differ from the image's).

Field.Label: Confirm
Field.Description: I understand this overwrites the controller's memory.

Field.Label: Then: Interfaces, Z-Wave, Disable. The plugin does the rest and talks you through it in the Event Log.
